Topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
Topology.Description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Azure VNet with a Red Hat OpenShift cluster, a central firewall, and a private connection to the on-premises datacenter.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' and an 'Asset Inventory Database', which suggests that an asset inventory is being maintained.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl3, nl4, nl5) and peering links (e.g., zl3, zl4) that document data flows between different zones and nodes.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive and non-sensitive data (z4 and z5) and peering links that segment data flows based on sensitivity (zl3, zl4).

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3) that manage traffic between different zones.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n8) and data flow links (nl4, nl5) that indicate DNS resolution is configured for both cloud and on-premises assets.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and a management link (nl10) that indicates MFA is required for remote access via the 'Azure Bastion' (n5).

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) and data flow links (nl6, nl7) that indicate DNS filtering is applied to both cloud and on-premises assets.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and data flow links (nl8, nl9) that indicate web proxy filtering is applied to both cloud and on-premises assets.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7) and links that demonstrate a segmented and secure network architecture.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Zone' (z3) with nodes like 'Azure Monitor' (n6), 'Azure PaaS Services' (n7), and 'Identity Server' (n11) that suggest secure management practices.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and management links (nl10, nl14) that indicate centralized AAA is implemented.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN' link (zl1) and an 'Azure Bastion' (n5) that suggests remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n15) in the 'Management Zone' (z3) that is logically separated from other zones and has no direct internet access.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n12) and monitoring links (nl11) that indicate a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n2, n3) and peering links (zl3, zl4, zl5, zl6) that suggest traffic filtering is performed between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and management links (nl10, nl14) that suggest access control for remote assets is managed.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n16) and monitoring links (nl15) that suggest network traffic flow logs are collected.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n13) and monitoring links (nl12) that indicate a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

Control.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n14) and management links (nl13) that suggest port-level access control is deployed.

Control.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and data flow links (nl8, nl9) that indicate application layer filtering is performed.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive and non-sensitive data (z4 and z5) and peering links (zl3, zl4) that suggest separation of production and non-production systems.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n_new2) and a data flow link (nl_new2) that suggests periodic external penetration tests are performed.
